option_relations.rationale: Hepatic abscess (Staphylococcal) is a known complication of severe congenital neutropenia, which is the condition described by the leaf.
Liver Abscess (Staphylococcus aureus) is a known complication of severe congenital neutropenia, which is the condition described by the leaf.

Severe congenital neutropenia (SCN) with hepatic abscess caused by Staphylococcus aureus is a broader description that includes the ELANE gene mutation-associated severe congenital neutropenia (pred_1) and its complication.

Immunodeficiency Disorder (ELANE mutation-associated) is equivalent to ELANE gene mutation-associated severe congenital neutropenia (pred_1) as ELANE mutations are a known cause of severe congenital neutropenia, which is an immunodeficiency disorder.
